Word-formation item on 'paryatakon'. Cited at competency level because this 20-outcome frame has no morphology outcome - C-HIN4.2 is the language-system competency and its LO-220 covers USING words in writing, not analysing their formation.
Word-formation item on 'daudna'. Competency-level C-HIN4.2. NB the key ('daud + on') is wrong; the whole key column of this set appears shifted by one row.
Word-formation item on 'thaharna'. Competency-level C-HIN4.2. NB the key prints 'uhar' for 'thahar'.
Word-formation item on 'udaan'. Competency-level C-HIN4.2. NB the key gives 'ud + na' where 'udaan' is ud + aan.
Word-formation item on 'bharatiya'. Competency-level C-HIN4.2. NB the key gives 'Bharat + aan' where it should be Bharat + iya.
Word-formation item on 'sanskriti'. Competency-level C-HIN4.2. NB the key gives 'Sanskrit + iya', which belongs to the previous item - confirming the off-by-one corruption across this six-item set.
